title: Gems of Bhutan | Thimphu Punakha & Paro
highlights: Journey to the world’s greenest country graced by rich cultural heritage and breathtaking tropical beauty
Stand in awe before the sacred 177 ft Buddha statue that guards over the capital city of Thimphu
Discover the wilderness of Bhutan as you step into the home of its national animal, Takin, at the Motithang Takin Preserve
Capture the panoramic beauty of the snow-clad Himalayan peaks at the Dochula pass
Follow the trail of colorful prayer flags to the spiritual odyssey of Taktsang, the Tiger’s Nest
overview:
About the tour:
Your 6 Days Bhutan Sightseeing Tour journey begins with a seamless transfer to Thimphu, where the heartbeat of Bhutan echoes through vibrant markets and historic sites. The serene beauty of Punakha and the timeless valleys of Paro culminate in an awe-inspiring visit to Taktsang, the Tiger's Nest Monastery. It's an immersive journey, inviting you to connect with Bhutan's soul. Choose this experience for a curated blend of culture and nature.
Quick Facts:
Duration: 6 Days, 5 Nights
Start Point: Paro International Airport
End Point: Paro International Airport
Experiences Covered:
Thimphu Sightseeing
Punakha Sightseeing
Paro Sightseeing
exclusions: Meals not mentioned in the itinerary or inclusions

days.title: Arrival at Paro & Transfer to Thimphu | Welcome to Land of the Thunder Dragon
days.desc: Upon arrival at the Paro International Airport, complete the immigration process at the airport, then meet our local representative who will help you with your transfer to Thimphu. Upon reaching, head directly to the hotel & complete the check-in formalities. The rest of the day at leisure you’ll be free to explore the nearby local market of Thimphu. Dinner and overnight stay at the hotel in Thimphu.

items.title: Transfer in Creta, Toyota Hiace
items.desc: Upon reaching Paro International Airport our representative will help you with the transfer to your pre-booked hotel in Thimphu.

days.title: Thimphu Local Sightseeing | Explore Cultural Diversity
days.desc: Wake up this morning and enjoy a delicious breakfast. After breakfast driver will pick you up from the hotel for the local sightseeing which includes, National Memorial, Buddha Statue, and Motithang Takin Preserve. Next visit Tashichho Dzong, Simtokha Dzong the oldest Dzong of Bhutan, and Handicrafts Emporium followed by shopping for souvenirs at the local markets in Thimphu. Dinner and overnight at Hotel.

items.title: Transfer in Creta, Toyota Hiace
items.desc:
After breakfast driver will pick you up for the city tour.
Post city tour the driver will drop you back at the hotel for the overnight stay.

items.title: Local Sightseeing
items.desc:
You’ll proceed to visit the National Memorial Chorten that was built in the honour of late King Jigme Dorji Wangchuck.
Also visit the largest Buddha Statue that overlooks the beautiful Thimphu Valley and the Motithang Takin Preserve, the humble abode of Takin, the national animal of Bhutan.
Other highlights include a visit to the Tashichho Dzong, the seat of the national government, and the Central Monastic Body, including the summer residence of the Je Khenpo (Chief Abbot of Bhutan).
Later drive to Simtokha Dzong the oldest Dzong of Bhutan built by Zhabdrung in 1627 and finally visit the Handicrafts Emporium followed by shopping for souvenirs at the local markets in Thimphu.

days.title: Transfer to Punakha |  The Juncture of the two Beautiful Rivers
days.desc: Wake up this morning and enjoy a delicious breakfast. After check-out, the driver will pick you up from the hotel for the transfer to Punakha. En route, make a stopover at Dochula Pass and visit Chimi Lhakhang, and Punakha Dzong. Then the driver will drop you off at the pre-booked hotel in Punakha, and complete the check-in formalities. Dinner and an overnight stay at the hotel

items.title: Transfer in Creta, Toyota Hiace
items.desc:
After breakfast driver will pick you up from the hotel in Thimphu and en-route to Punakha you will take various stopovers for sightseeing.
Post sightseeing the driver will drop you off at the hotel in Punakha for an overnight stay.

items.title: Local Sightseeing
items.desc:
If the weather is clear, we stop for a while at Dochula Pass to view the Higher Himalayas.
Visit Chimi Lhakhang, also known as “the Temple of Fertility” built by Lama Drukpa Kuenley who subdued the demons with his “Magical Thunderbolt”.
Visit Punakha Dzong, situated between Pho Chu (the male river) and Mo Chu (the female river), which for many years until the time of the second king, served as the seat of the Government.

days.title: Transfer to Paro | Paro Sightseeing
days.desc: The day begins with the morning breakfast. Post breakfast, the driver will pick you up for transfer to Paro. On reaching, check in to the hotel and take some rest. You'll then, visit Drukgyel Dzong a fortress and Buddhist monastery, next explore Kichu Lhakhang, built in 659 A.D by the Tibetan king Songtsen Gampo Namgyal. Return to hotel for dinner and overnight stay.

items.title: Transfer in Creta, Toyota Hiace
items.desc:
The driver will pick you up from the hotel in Punakha and take you to Paro 
After completing the check-in formalities, the driver will pick you up from the hotel for sightseeing.
After sightseeing, the driver will drop you off at the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Paro Sightseeing
items.desc:
Firstly you will visit the ruins of the Drukgyel Dzong a fortress and Buddhist monastery, now in ruins, located in the upper part of the Paro. Built by, Shabdrung Ngawang Namgyal, father and unifier of medieval Bhutan, the dzong was destroyed by accidental fire and left in ruins as an evocative reminder of the great victories it was built to commemorate.
Spend some time exploring the ramparts and on a clear day, experience an unforgettable view of Mt. Jhomolhari.
On the way back, visit Kichu Lhakhang, built in 659 A.D by the Tibetan king Songtsen Gampo.

days.title: Excursion to Taktsang | A Beautiful Hike to Taktsang Monastery (Tiger’s Nest)
days.desc: Start your day with a healthy breakfast and then proceed for an excursion to Taktsang Monastery. Reach the base of the trail to Tiger's Nest from where a 6.5 km hike will take you to the monastery. The trail climbs through a beautiful pine forest and an occasional grove of fluttering prayer flags to reach Taktsang. Take a break at Taktsang Cafeteria located mid-way and then climb 700 steps at the last leg of the hike. Later, return back to the hotel for dinner and overnight stay.

items.title: Transfer in Creta, Toyota Hiace
items.desc:
The driver will pick you up from the hotel for the excursion to Taktsang Monastery (Tiger’s Nest).
Post excursion the driver will take you back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Hike to Taktsang
items.desc:
The trail climbs through a beautiful pine forest and an occasional grove of fluttering prayer flags to reach Taktsang Monastery.
The Monastery was built around Guru Rinpoche's meditation cave & clings to the edge of a rock cliff that plunges 900 meters into the valley below.
You can then visit Ta Dzong, an ancient watchtower, which now houses the National Museum below which is the Paro Rinpung Dzong (literally meaning “Heap of Jewels”).
Proceed for a short walk to the base of the dzong and across a traditional cantilevered, covered bridge.

days.title: Departure from Paro | Wave Goodbye to the Land of Thunder Dragon
days.desc: Enjoy the morning with a delicious breakfast. Check out from the hotel and the driver will help you with the transfer back to the Paro International Airport with a huge smile.

items.title: Transfer in Creta, Toyota Hiace
items.desc: Post breakfast, the driver will help you with the transfer to the Airport.
